strings.en: I've got years on you lot!
This'll be decided in an instant!
Skills like that won't keep you alive out here!
I won't lose to you youngsters yet!
I won't give you a chance to run!
I didn't become the Aggressors' captain/　for nothing...!
Noticing now won't help--it's too late!
I'll send you to your grave myself!
This range... is perfect for the Type-G!
Feel the power of the Gespenst!
This machine is like my own body...!
I'll show you what the Gespenst can do!
I'll show you what this Kai can do!
Behold the power of the reborn Gespenst!
I'll show you this is no mere/　minor variant!
Don't think this is just any Gespenst!
Behold the fruits of the Halloween Plan!
Get a good taste of the Kai's power!
No one handles a Gespenst better than me!
I'll show you what the Type-Haken can do!
If it's humanoid, even a Gadisword unit...!
I'll take on the Zovorg commander unit!
Take battle lightly and you'll get worse than burned!
Young whelp... I'll take you on!
I'll show you techniques honed over the years!
Jua-Mu! I'll beat that rotten nature out of you!
A duel between commanders. You'll accept it!
His range is my range too!
I can't carelessly dive into his reach...!
I won't let that Raftclans keep its distance!
I won't let you do as you please, Karo-Ran!
Karo-Ran.../　If there's no opening, I'll make one!
I'll be putting an end to this fight!
Gu-Landon... I can't forgive your crimes!
Perish along with your ambitions, Gu-Landon!
I won't fall behind a Golaikunru mercenary!
The unexpected is nothing unusual/　on the battlefield!
That Raig-Geios is not to be taken lightly...!
I won't play to your pace!
His kind are the ones to watch out for...!
You know the truth,/　yet still choose to follow Herluga...!
I can't waste time on Reggiane!
A man enthralled by the Cross Gate...!
You must know it too:/　the Cross Gate can't be controlled!
Don't think size decides a fight!
Debudedabide, showing up now of all times...!
He may look like that, but he's dangerous...!
If it's unmanned, I won't hold back!
They may be friendly units, but it can't be helped!
Whatever it possesses, the solution's the same!
Possessing that unit was a mistake!
The Yokijin have to be eliminated either way!
Concentrate fire on the Crystal Dragoon!
So remnants of the Dark Brain still existed...!
Skull Knight, I won't let you have your way!
I'll have to watch out for that lance...!
I won't listen to the drivel/　of a machine that's lost its purpose!
XN-L! Whatever your origins,/　I'll take you down here!
I've already worked out how to deal with that unit!
No matter how many times/　you come to the Earth Sphere!
I won't let you have your way, Golaikunru!
I won't let you near those two!
Heh, you're worth trading blows with head-on!
This seems different from the Zovorg units so far...
I'll find out what this new model really is!
No matter how many forces the Fury send...!
I won't lose a collision to a Big Shoulder!
Leave that White Horn to me!
I'll snap that horn right off!
All units, use extreme caution against the Thorn!
I'll find out what they're after...!
Securing the Hagane and Hiryu's retreat route!
If you're going to resort to force...!
That large unit's got a skilled pilot...!
If our weapons work on them,/　there's only one thing to do!
Lamaris, I won't let you run wild any longer!
We need to thin out the Lamaris!
We must wipe out the unknowns before this drags on!
I'll make sure to bring down the Kaana type!
Leave the big Lamaris to me!
No time to waste. Hit the Kaana type all at once!
We must stop that giant Lamaris at all costs!
We must hurry and wipe out the Ida type!
Don't think you can overpower me with that strength!
What is the Ares Geist after...?!
All units! Draw the Ares Geist/　away from the Cross Gate!
I won't let these monsters run wild!
I won't let you go any further!
You got careless...!/　You're not getting away!
I won't miss my chance to counter!
You misread the flow of battle!
Sorry! I'm leaving the rest to you!
Ngh! This is too much, even for me...!!
Hmph, you failed to finish me off!
A sloppy finish can cost you your life!
I-I have no intention of retiring here!
Guh! To take a direct hit!!
Blast it, I'm shaming/　the Instructors' name!
Blast it! At this rate, I'm setting a poor/　example for the young ones!
He's on another level from the Raftclans...!
Nngh, so this is the power of the Siebe Drive!
As a remnant of the Dark Brain,/　it's no pushover either...!
Ngh! Damn Lamaris, running wild as they please!
If you mean to beat me,/　come at me like your life depends on it!
I'm not going down yet!/　Hit me with everything you've got!
A direct hit!? Damn you, don't get cocky!
Hoh, so you've got some backbone.
Blast, the young ones will laugh at me.
Still neck and neck! The real fight starts now!
This one's even tougher than the Kai model!
I'll give you that much, Al-Van!
He's a seasoned fighter.../　I can't let my guard down!
I can't afford to lose to you!
Fu-Ruu, that's not enough to beat me!
Ngh! You do have the skill/　to lead the knights...!
I never expected to come out unscathed...!/　But I won't lose!
Keeping a cool face while pushing hard, eh!
I won't let the Gyanonia overpower me!
We have to pull it away from the Cross Gate quickly!
Tch! Toyed with by a puppet...!
Ngh! It's stronger than the Dark Brain...!
Ngh! I know their tricks, but...!
I won't be beaten by small fry like you!
Hmph, a commander after all. Fairly skilled.
Blast, I couldn't read his blade!
The Lamaris are getting more active...!
Tch, I can't underestimate their numbers!
That won't be enough to stop/　Kai Kitamura!
I couldn't shake that one off...!
I can recover from this much.
Good step-in, but just landing a hit won't do.
Hmph, there's a knack to taking a hit, too.
My Kai model can take this much.
Its frame is sturdier than before.
That's not enough to stop the Boxer!
Struggling just to keep up with the Gunner?
The Type-Haken's armor speaks for itself.
That move just now... Only a human could do that.
Hmph, trying to provoke me, So-Des?
You can read this motion, Al-Van?!
Is that it? The Emperor Unit seems off its game.
Skull Knight, quick on the step-in!
I won't be beaten by a puppet!
I'll keep drawing the enemy in!
What's wrong, monster?! Is that it?!
Hmph, all you can do is swarm?
Ngh! I can't shake off the Lamaris...
Damn Lamaris.../　It's more troublesome now that it's grown.
The Ares Geist has gotten faster!
Your drive can't match mine! Drive!
Put some real spirit into it!
That won't cut it against the Instructors.
Your sense of distance is all wrong.
It's leagues beyond the standard type.
If it's a Gespenst, the basics are the same.
As captain of the Instructors,/　I must handle even alien units.
You seem unable to handle/　that commander unit's performance.
I told you not to underestimate Earthlings, Jua-Mu!
Fu-Ruu... Your moves are efficient,/　but they won't work on me!
Don't think you can stop me that easily,/　Gu-Landon!
Reggiane, you're trying to buy time.
You can't control the Cross Gate!
Your strange tricks won't work on me!
You won't hit me, Crystal Dragoon!
XN-L, I don't care about your mission!
I've already got the Zovorg units' patterns down.
Not much different from the Zovorg units.
I won't be beaten by Lamaris!
The Ares Geist.../　It's faster than before!
I have no interest in playing with monsters!
Go wash your face and try again!
Put more variety into your motions!
Nice motion. But it's pointless/　if it doesn't connect.
I know how to handle this machine.
See for yourself what this model can do!
I have no intention of entertaining you.
Karo-Ran, not showing your hand, eh.
The battlefield isn't as easy as you think,/　Gomoudokka!
Don't think that'll ever reach me.
Tch... What am I doing, letting that happen?
I need to tighten my aim.
...They had me dancing to their tune.
Hmph, straight out of the textbook.
So you managed to blind me.
I'll make sure to finish this!
Well done. Leave the rest to me.
I won't let an opening like that slip!
I'll show you the Instructor Unit's teamwork!
Leaving the rest to me, Gilliam?
I'll lend you a hand, Sänger!
Sänger, leave the rest to me!
This timing... You haven't changed, Rätsel.
Heh, you factored in my moves too?
Wait, Arado!/　Where do you think you're going!?
Arado! You want me to clean up after you!?
Arado! You forgot to finish the job!
Hope I'd back him up, did he?
Lamia, leave the rest to me!
Hugo, leave the rest to me!
I'll lend you a hand, Hugo!
Rim, I'll take it from here!
Kota, there's more to fighting/　than just looking straight ahead!
You're charging in too far, Akimi!
I'll back you up, Soul Saber!
Akemi, leave the rest to me!
You seem used to teamwork, Haken!
Al-Van, I'll lend you a hand!
I'll back you up, SRX Team!
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
You're too focused on the enemy!
Your evasive maneuvers are a mess!
I'll take this one for you!
Arado! You're getting a lecture later!!
I keep a close eye on my subordinates!
You won't lay a hand on my subordinates!
How many times do I have to tell you?!
That opening is why you're pushed back!
Don't assume help will always come!
Don't push out too far, Hugo!
Aqua, don't let your guard down!
Touma! What do you think you're doing?!
Akimi, don't let your guard down!
This is what happens when you bunch up!
I'll settle this in one go!
Couldn't get away in time, eh?
That's what you get for staying put!
Seems you weren't watching your flanks!
Giganscudo! Burn it all to ashes!!
Heh, a weapon made for me.
I'll show you how sharp this is!
I'll get nowhere unless I close the gap!
You can't stop this Continuous Attack!
Bunker! I'll pump in every round!!
Even if I have to empty every round!
At this distance,/　Short Range Mode!
It can handle enemies up close, too!
Don't think you can stop my fist!
I won't say one fist is all I need!
But don't underestimate a single fist!!
That was just to pin you down!
Here's the real deal! Long Range Mode!
PTs aren't shaped like humans/　just for show!
I'll show you its utility and potential!!
A Continuous Attack/　only the Type-G can pull off!
Power is overcome by/　speed, flow and strike!
I won't be stopped that easily!!
First, break their spirit with speed!
Then, work the recoil into the flow!!
Behold the Super Fighter's/　finishing sword!
That was a fine edge indeed.
There's no stopping this mighty sword.
I'll hit you with every weapon I've got!
Behold,/　the combination of Raptor and Bison!
A specially made blade... savor it!
A strike from the heavens! Take it!!
Even a simple motion works if you use it right!
Diving in with my whole body!
Hitting you with everything the Boxer's got!
How do you like the power of fist and sword?!
Eleve 1 to all units!/　Clear the Gunner's line of fire!
This motion won't be easy to read!
Keep them pinned while taking distance!
I'll show you the true essence of the Type-Haken!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Though I prefer to finish with a kick.
Wouldn't a hip attack be better~?
I'll slam it right into you!!
It's a money pit, but its performance is top-notch!
Don't think you can stop it easily!
Bringing it into my weapon's range!
